Check the envelope: status, outputs within the declared tolerance, inputs echo (inputs used == inputs submitted); every Taylor result declares its radius estimate (labelled an estimate) and marks each evaluation point inside/outside it with the last-term scale beside the value; accelerated values (Aitken Δ² / Wynn epsilon) are reported BESIDE the unaccelerated last term, never instead of it; Laurent series are named follow-on scope, and perturbation problems are served by composition (the DAE/BVP solvers with the small parameter swept), not by a dedicated target here.

Adversarial: NaN / 1e300 input → INVALID_INPUT with the field named; missing f, m, n, name, or points → NOT_COMPUTED naming the field; a substituted input → NOT_COMPUTED input_substituted; a bare number on a dimensional input → refused unless the unit is declared (SC-04 leg, expected-fail until built).
